summary: NAESP supports the continuation of the E-Rate program and urges the FCC to reject proposals to eliminate or substantially restrict it. The National Association of Elementary School Principals (NAESP) opposes proposals to condition E-Rate eligibility or funding on academic outcomes, screen-time limits, or other technology policies, emphasizing the responsibility of state and local education leaders. NAESP urges the FCC to maintain a strong E-Rate program as it currently operates and reject new conditions tied to extraneous outcomes or decisions.
